statement: Case rows in group DoD-D4. A row verdict is not runtime_pass and is not a product PASS.

rows.expected: N12 writeback failure makes N13 writeback_state FAILED and body is not OK
N12 success makes writeback_state OK legally while N11 stays BLOCKED
handoff follows the N11 condition: missing reviewer is NOT_READY; a PASS envelope is READY; a BLOCKED/REVISE envelope is NOT_READY
rows.note: READY here is the helper applied to a synthetic envelope. run_standard on this VM stays NOT_READY because no verified original exists. GAP-01 remains OPEN. This is not a constant swap and not a product PASS.

rows.expected: run_standard does not assign writeback_state or handoff_state as a bare constant
same store, intent, and blocker: second call and a new process do not notify again
a different intent is not suppressed by the same blocker label
another store still notifies; two stores are not used as the dedup proof
no module-level mutable set is the dedup bucket; shape sets are not that bucket
rows.note: N11_KEYS, N12_KEYS, and N13_KEYS are input-shape sets. They are not the notification bucket. Dedup is store/board/notifications.json, shown by DOD-D4-SAME across a second process.

rows.expected: a second run_standard on the same store and intent suppresses the same blocker
